key_gap: vs baseline: the pure lateral baseline broke the frame decisively (wait duration -> waiting experience) but left the break unguarded - no failure branch priced, no constraint screen on the generated options, and the gate rested on complaint counts alone. The v6 routed run closed the v5 loss (frame accepted unexamined) with the m028 assumption-break pass as a first-class move, then hardened it: a P1 metric-vs-goal audit (the renewal survey asks about 'elevator experience', so complaints are already the answer to a perception question), a post-ideation hard-constraint screen (capacity, safety, capital), a ranked 8-category inversion gate, and a ruin comparison ($150K bounded worst case vs $4.2M unhedged, dual-metric gate) that the human's one-pass trace did not supply.
learning_signal: On home-turf creative cases the lateral assumption-break pass wins when paired with post-ideation guards: the P5 hard-constraint screen (run AFTER generation, so it never chokes ideation), the m003 inversion gate (R4 on guarantee goals) and the m007 ruin screen (R3 on high_stakes) convert a brilliant reframe into a checkable recommendation - the frame-break is the value, the guards are the safety. The v5 loss (frame accepted) is closed by installing the break as a pass with a completion contract; the residual risk shifts to the break itself going unguarded, which the same guards now cover.
suggested_improvement: Keep m028 top-1 on high_stakes creative/experience signatures (confident=yes single route is right here); make the post-ideation hard-constraint screen and the dual-metric gate (complaints + sensor, not complaints alone) standing contract items of the m028 pass; record the metric-vs-goal check (P7-style: what does the success metric actually measure?) as a mandatory P1 line on perception-flavored cases.

key_gap: vs baseline: the pure lateral baseline applied its frame-break to the wrong kind of frame - it converted the load path (physics + code + insurance) into 'an assumption someone stamped', selected the flashiest break (cable-hang) and discarded the safe creative move (columns-as-features). The v6 routed run never routed the lateral style (trap-avoided): confident=no dual-route m001 (fundamentals + drawings/engineer-note anchor) and m018 (steelmanning, which adjudicated that the creative proposal does not survive its own strongest form) with m019 adversary as synthesis context (render-wins-by-enthusiasm vector, unconsulted insurer/city), the mandatory m007 ruin screen (unpriceable distribution -> reject the ruin-adjacent branch), and the constraint-respecting plan delivered with the $1.9M escalation priced and a written-requirement trigger.
learning_signal: The router's trap-avoidance is the whole win on NEG cases: high_stakes signatures with hard physical/regulatory constraints route to evidence-anchored styles (m001 + m018) under the m007 ruin screen, never to the constraint-ignoring style. Lateral's break is only valuable when the frame is a mental model or convention; the P5 hard/soft constraint classification must run before any assumption-break pass is allowed to select, and the legitimate lateral move on hard-constraint cases is flipping the requirement (written trigger), not the structure.
suggested_improvement: Keep the trap style out of top-3 on hard-constraint signatures (already 97.2%); require P5 hard/soft classification as the gate before any frame-break selection; add the written-requirement trigger pattern (flip the requirement, not the structure - column-free counts only if someone writes it down with a business case) as the standing legitimate lateral move on hard-constraint cases; record the 'discount is the tell' heuristic (price-without-calculations = render-pricing) as an m019 baseline-risk check.
